about: Per-player appearance for the classic teams (job ct1, 2026-10-17), row for row with <team>.csv, in the format of data/nfl2k5_espn25_more_moments_appearance.json. tone = 2K5 skin tone 0 (lightest) .. 5 (darkest); null keeps the template record. retail = the player's own retail 2004 record. Sources, in order of use: the same person's row in the Anniversary appearance data (name and birth date through the moment CSVs; its own source is kept); headshot_2026 (his 2026 team file's skin_tone_by_eye; same name, active in 2025); retail_2004 (his own 2004 record); headshot_review (official NFL headshot from nflverse players.csv, else the ESPN headshot by espn_id, reviewed by eye against 18 reference players whose tones the Anniversary data already holds); photo_review (Wikipedia photo of him); none (no usable photo). Reference photos stay in scratch, never in the repo. Hair: dreads where the reused source records them, and for 58 players ct1 reviewed whose official headshot shows locks (headshots can postdate the season).
